declared_before: any evaluation of the FINAL split; no candidate was scored on weeks 10-17 when this file was committed

data.observed_usage: lib/game-distribution/data/observed_role_game_2025.csv (OUTCOME side only for any target game)
data.injury_designations: lib/role-calibration/data/injury_reports.csv (nflverse FINAL team-week designation; no publication timestamp exists)
data.depth_chart: UNAVAILABLE for 2025 (snapshots begin 2026-08-25): depth features are not used

VAL.use: choose among the declared ridge grid; may be inspected repeatedly

FINAL.use: evaluated exactly once after the candidate is frozen (FROZEN.json); never used to choose anything

splits.EXCLUDED: weeks 1-2 (no as-of profile), week 18 and playoffs (no as-of profile), all 2026 weeks (no stat lines and no as-of profile with an outcome in the repo)

scorings.PRIMARY: HALF (identical to the W1.P2 proxy scoring: 0.5 PPR, 4pt pass TD, -2 INT/fumble lost, 2pt = 2)

baselines.B0p: PROXY source projection: mean fantasy points over the player's previous up to 4 games (strictly earlier, same season). There is NO stored history of the real Sleeper/RotoWire source projection, so this is NOT the real source. Same proxy as W1.P2.
baselines.B1p: Wave 1 canonical-like champion = production evaluateInjuryModel (production priors, source_semantics CONDITIONAL_ON_ACTIVE) applied to B0p with the historical designation and practice status
baselines.caveat: A proxy baseline knows less about role than a real source projection. Any Role gain over B1p is an UPPER BOUND on gain over the real Wave 1 canonical forecast.

population.requires: as-of profile row, B0p present, B0p(HALF) >= 3.0 (relevance floor)
population.actual: stat-line points; a player with no stat line scores 0 (DNP is an outcome, not an exclusion)
population.out_designation: evaluated only to prove the Role contribution is exactly 0 for OUT players

candidates.C1: the existing Role shadow EXACTLY as it exists (lib/role-calibration/shadow.ts, kappa 0.3, confidence weights, cap max(1, 25%)) on baseline B1p, xFP from the committed 2025 yield table (same-season table: mild leakage that FAVORS C1)

C2.name: Role residual challenger
C2.target: actual points - B0p, on rows where the player played (snaps > 0) and designation in {NONE, QUESTIONABLE, DOUBTFUL}: availability is the injury layer's job and is NOT learned here
C2.model: per-position, per-scoring ridge regression on standardized features, intercept unpenalized, fit on DEV only
C2.ridge_choice: lowest VAL MAE of C2 vs actual, per position; ties -> larger lambda
C2.shrinkage: delta = confidence_weight * clamp(prediction, -cap, +cap), confidence_weight = existing ROLE_SHADOW_CONF_WEIGHT (MEDIUM 1, LOW 0.6, INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE 0); cap = max(1.0, 0.25*|B0p|) (the existing shadow convention, not re-tuned)
C2.application: C2 expected = production evaluateInjuryModel(source_points = B0p + delta): the Role delta is a CONDITIONAL-ON-ACTIVE correction and the Wave 1 injury model supplies availability exactly once
C2.missing_data: Role not applicable (primary feature null or confidence INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE) => delta = 0, neutral

C0.name: Role-free control
C0.model: identical ridge procedure, features = [b0] only; identical cap, confidence weight, injury application
C0.purpose: isolates the part of any C2 gain that does not need Role information

role_opportunity_gate_G1.population: players who played (snaps > 0) with a covered forecast
role_opportunity_gate_G1.pass: Role forecast MAE < last-game MAE by >= 3% AND <= season-to-date mean MAE * 1.02 AND <= last-3 mean MAE * 1.02, on FINAL, per position-metric with N >= 200 (QB N >= 60)

promotion_thresholds_G2.applies_to: each of RB, WR, TE, QB separately, on FINAL, headline designations, primary scoring HALF, vs champion B1p
promotion_thresholds_G2.T1_coverage_and_n: covered rows >= 70% of eligible rows AND covered FINAL rows >= 300 (RB/WR/TE) or >= 120 (QB)
promotion_thresholds_G2.T2_mae: delta_MAE = MAE(B1p) - MAE(C2) >= 0.05 points AND the 95% cluster-bootstrap lower bound > 0 (clusters = team-week)
promotion_thresholds_G2.T5_consistency: delta_MAE > 0 in at least 3 of the 4 FINAL weeks AND delta_MAE(VAL) > 0
promotion_thresholds_G2.T6_decisions: among decided disagreement pairs (|actual difference| >= 1 point), N >= 100 AND challenger wins >= champion wins AND one-sided binomial p < 0.10; fewer than 100 decided pairs => NOT promotable
promotion_thresholds_G2.T7_tiers: no tier (STARTER/FLEX/FRINGE) with N >= 100 has delta_MAE < -0.10
promotion_thresholds_G2.T8_injury_and_cap: delta_MAE on QUESTIONABLE+DOUBTFUL rows >= -0.05; contribution on OUT rows == 0 exactly; cap-hit rate <= 10%
promotion_thresholds_G2.T9_leakage: structural point-in-time assertions pass on every row; the ORACLE control (target-game actual opportunity as features) beats C2 by a wide margin (harness is sensitive); the PERMUTATION control (features shuffled within week) shows delta_MAE <= 0.02
promotion_thresholds_G2.T10_robustness: delta_MAE(B1p - C2) > 0 AND delta_MAE(C0 - C2) > 0 under BOTH robustness scorings (STD, PPR)
promotion_thresholds_G2.T11_sentinel: informational, never sufficient: the only REAL-source evidence in the repo (docs/PROJECTION_CALIBRATION_PHASE2_CERTIFICATION.md, 2026 week 3, n=769, real source baseline) showed delta MAE -0.006 for C1 and no kappa helping
promotion_thresholds_G2.T2b_role_specific_increment: delta_MAE(C0 - C2) >= 0.03 points AND the 95% cluster-bootstrap lower bound > 0 on FINAL: the Role features must beat the Role-free shrinkage control, not only the proxy champion

verdict_mapping.all_of T1-T10_pass_for_a_position: all of T1, T2, T2b, T3-T10 pass for that position => that position is a PROMOTION CANDIDATE
verdict_mapping.any_position_candidate: OFFLINE CERTIFIED — PROMOTION CANDIDATE, LIVE/STAGING GATE PENDING (strongest allowed offline verdict; never PROMOTED)
verdict_mapping.none: SHADOW_ONLY (architecture and prospective capture may still ship)

pending_live_gates: prospective final-pregame Role challenger capture over completed real weeks
G3: incremental value over the REAL Wave 1 canonical forecast (real source projections) on prospective weeks

amendments.when: after inspecting DEV-only fits, before any VAL or FINAL evaluation
amendments.change: added control candidate C0 (Role-free regression-to-the-mean) and threshold T2b/T10b
amendments.why: DEV coefficients showed the baseline feature b0 carries a large NEGATIVE coefficient: the 4-game-mean proxy baseline over-predicts and a plain shrinkage correction needs no Role information at all. Gain of C2 over B1p would therefore be dominated by a defect of the PROXY baseline, not by Role. The Role-specific increment is C2 vs C0.

role_free_note: If C0 beats B1p but C2 does not beat C0, the finding is: the proxy baseline needs shrinkage (a source-projection calibration matter), Role adds nothing measurable.
